range.tooltip:
Left = carrot spots within the max area level when this run was planned (already visited ones included); right = all carrot spots.
With "Follow knowledge level" on, the max is your real knowledge level - 1; once your knowledge level is maxed (level {cap}) the "Max area level" setting is used instead.
To cover more spots, raise "Max area level" (up to {ceiling}) or turn off following the knowledge level.

draw_line_to_carrots.label: Draw line to Carrots
draw_line_to_carrots.tooltip: Render a line from your character's position to nearby carrots.

alert_carrots.label: Play a sound when a carrot is found
alert_carrots.tooltip:
In the Occult Crescent, play a sound once when a new carrot comes into view. Each carrot sounds only once; the record resets when you leave the island.
Each alert also writes an Information line to the Dalamud log ([BOCCHI][胡蘿蔔]).
No game actions. On (default) = sound. Off = no sound.

carrot_alert_sound.label: Alert sound
carrot_alert_sound.tooltip: Sound effect number 1-16, the same sounds as <se.1>-<se.16> in chat.

praise_carrots.label: Ask Tataru to say a line when a carrot is found
praise_carrots.tooltip:
When a new carrot comes into view, ask the Tataru Praise plugin to say a line (its situation: 發現幸運胡蘿蔔). Each carrot only once.
Also needs "Praise occult events" on the critical encounter settings page, Tataru Praise installed and enabled, and that situation synthesized once; does nothing when it is not installed. Each call writes a line to the Dalamud log ([BOCCHI][塔塔露]).
No game actions. On (default) = ask. Off = never call.

repeat_carrot_hunt.label: Repeat
repeat_carrot_hunt.tooltip: Start the hunt again after reaching the final node
